messages:
liz_sales: Heads-up — Acme's vendor risk team just flagged IAM evidence as a blocker for the deal. They asked for SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement evidence, RBAC role matrix, and a short write-up on least-privilege controls. Need this compiled by EOD tomorrow. Anyone can pull artifacts?

sam_sec: I can own the security write-up + screenshots of policy configs. Quick Q: do they want SP metadata or IdP metadata?

liz_sales: They asked for IdP xml + confirmation we can provide SAML metadata for the hosted API endpoints. Also they want to see MFA enforced for all users with admin roles.

jordan_eng: I can export SAML metadata from the platform. Command I use: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/saml/metadata > redwood-saml-metadata.xml
```
That will be the IdP/SP metadata depending on which side you're federating.

alex_sre: For MFA evidence, we can pull an audit report from Okta and a sample login flow recording. Okta has an export: 
```bash
okta logs query "eventType eq \"user.session.start\" and factorsUsed.exists()" --since 30d > mfa-events.json
```
I can sanitize sample rows (no PII) and attach.

maria_prod: For RBAC, we have the roles matrix in Confluence: /docs/ops/iam/roles-matrix. I will snapshot the current role->permission table and add notes on least-privilege mapping (who has admin, who has read-only, service account roles).

sam_sec: I'll also include our policy snippet that enforces MFA for admin actions. Example policy line: 
```yaml
access_control:
  require_mfa_for_actions:
    - role: admin
      actions:
        - manage_models
        - change_billing
```
We can couple that with logs showing MFA challenge occurred during an admin session.

liz_sales: Perfect. Can we put everything in a single ZIP and upload to the secure S3 share? Customer prefers a signed bundle.

alex_sre: Yes — once we have artifacts I'll upload to the s3 presigned link. Use this internal ticket to collect: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SALES-8921.

sam_sec: Tagging what I'll provide: security_writeup.pdf (description + controls), mfa-export-30d.json (sanitized), mfa-screenshots.zip.

jordan_eng: I will provide redwood-saml-metadata.xml and a short README explaining endpoints and cert thumbprints.

maria_prod: I'll attach roles-matrix.csv and a small mapping doc that shows least-privilege decisions for key roles.

okta-bot: Reminder: Okta export job queued. ETA ~ 2m.

deploy-bot: build 5421 passed on branch iam-evidence (ci:ok). :white_check_mark:

liz_sales: Thanks — can each person confirm ETA? I need to update Acme.

sam_sec: Security write-up + sanitized logs by 15:00 PT today.

jordan_eng: SAML metadata + README by 16:00 PT.

alex_sre: Upload to shared link by 17:00 PT.

maria_prod: Roles matrix + mapping by 17:00 PT.

liz_sales: Great. I'll bundle and sign then send to Acme with the SOC/third-party annex references. Please drop final files here when ready. :pray:

alex_sre: Uploaded preliminary bundle to the internal share: https://s3.redwood.internal/presigned/SALES-8921/iam-evidence-prelim.zip (will replace with signed bundle after final docs).

sam_sec: Uploaded security_writeup.pdf and mfa-export-30d.json (sanitized).

jordan_eng: Uploaded redwood-saml-metadata.xml + README.

maria_prod: Uploaded roles-matrix.csv and least-privilege-mapping.docx.

liz_sales: Sending to Acme now. Message I used: "Attached: SSO metadata, MFA evidence (sanitized), RBAC matrix, and a summary of our least-privilege controls. Let us know if you need raw logs or additional artefacts; we can escalate to a signed NDA delivery for sensitive exports."

sam_sec: Noted — if they request raw logs we'll route through security for redaction and legal for NDA.

liz_sales: Acme replied: "Looks good — can you confirm MFA is enforced for all console/admin users, and are service accounts separated from human accounts?"

alex_sre: Replying to Acme: Yes — MFA required for roles with admin privileges (policy + audit included). Service accounts are scoped to specific service roles and use key-based creds; they do not have console access. I added a short section in the RBAC doc describing service account restrictions.

liz_sales: Thanks team, closing this blocker for now. I'll update the deal status in Salesforce. :rocket:
